set -eu
ulimit -c 0
lockf -t 0 /tmp/g121-mac.lock python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,os,platform,shlex,shutil,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
revision="9e346b16408ea7d0353ac16808b285637071cf20"
files=[{"name":"managed_alloc.rs","sha256":"7f59e4732260b41b0f9a4e47f3c1a94f73d579f9c52fbb71e4fbbb0db26c2abc","base64":""},{"name":"native_faults.rs","sha256":"3946267e81571fcfd1c0853b1033bf170ef45632a7d9d99d747bef9ffd710513","base64":""}]
assert sys.platform=="darwin" and platform.machine()=="arm64", "macOS ARM64 only"
minimum_free=30*(1<<30)
def headroom():
    free=shutil.disk_usage(Path.home()).free
    if free < minimum_free:
        raise RuntimeError("policy floor: hold builds below30GiB; free="+str(free))
    return free
before_free=headroom()
print(json.dumps({"headroom_before":before_free,"minimum_free_bytes":minimum_free,"machine":platform.machine()}),flush=True)
rustc=Path(subprocess.check_output(["rustup","which","--toolchain","1.98.1","rustc"],text=True).strip())
assert rustc.is_file(), "installed compiler required; no toolchain download"
source=Path.home()/("managed-allocation-metrics-source-macos-"+revision)
target=Path.home()/("managed-allocation-metrics-target-macos-"+revision)
records=Path.home()/("managed-allocation-metrics-light-macos-"+revision)
for p in (source,target,records):
    assert not p.exists(), "private paths must be new: "+str(p)
for p in (source,target,records):
    p.mkdir()
scratch=target/"tmp"
scratch.mkdir()
env=dict(os.environ)
env["TMPDIR"]=str(scratch)
env["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"]="1"
def write_json(name,value):
    (records/name).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+chr(10))
def file_sha(path):
    digest=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        while data:=stream.read(1<<16):
            digest.update(data)
    return digest.hexdigest()
for item in files:
    data=base64.b64decode(item["base64"],validate=True)
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==item["sha256"]
    with (source/item["name"]).open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(data)
write_json("source.json",{"revision":revision,"files":[{k:val for k,val in item.items() if k!="base64"} for item in files]})
write_json("environment.json",{"system":platform.system(),"release":platform.release(),"machine":platform.machine(),"macos":platform.mac_ver()[0],"headroom_before":before_free,"minimum_free_bytes":minimum_free,"admission":"cpus=1,mem=1g,disk=2g; sync:false; serial standalone units only","source":str(source),"target":str(target),"records":str(records),"shared_build_lock":"/tmp/g121-mac.lock","scope":"same unmodified Rust modules, no global registration/caller/VM/native fault query/profile/campaign/ROOTcache write","python":{"executable":str(Path(sys.executable).resolve()),"version":sys.version,"sha256":file_sha(Path(sys.executable).resolve())},"rustc":{"executable":str(rustc),"sha256":file_sha(rustc)}})
version=subprocess.run([str(rustc),"-Vv"],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
(records/"rustc.txt").write_bytes(version.stdout)
assert b"host: aarch64-apple-darwin" in version.stdout
def check(name,argv):
    free=headroom()
    write_json(name+".command.json",{"argv":argv,"cwd":str(source),"TMPDIR":str(scratch),"timeout_seconds":40,"headroom_before":free})
    with (records/(name+".log")).open("wb") as stream:
        try:
            outcome=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=source,env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=40)
            code=outcome.returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            code=124
    (records/(name+".exit")).write_text(str(code)+chr(10))
    return code
outcomes={}
binaries=[]
for module in ("managed_alloc","native_faults"):
    binary=target/(module+"-tests")
    build=check(module+"-build",[str(rustc),"--edition","2024","--test","-D","warnings","-C","codegen-units=1","--target","aarch64-apple-darwin",str(source/(module+".rs")),"-o",str(binary)])
    outcomes[module+"-build"]=build
    if build==0:
        binaries.append({"module":module,"path":str(binary),"bytes":binary.stat().st_size,"sha256":file_sha(binary)})
        outcomes[module+"-test"]=check(module+"-test",[str(binary),"--test-threads=1","--nocapture"])
write_json("binaries.json",binaries)
write_json("outcomes.json",outcomes)
write_json("root-owed.json",{"unrun":["actual changed cost caller/helper compilation and native probes","normal managed-output caller tests on changed source","actual fault/read/identity failure paths","same-N paired/interleaved release profiling with caller-supplied n","parent/foreign-C/daemon/VM/guest/kernel/copy/CPU attribution","instrumentation perturbation/noise/contention","root adversarial/mutation/exact restoration/cleanup/matrix gates"],"note":"these standalone units are not the managed_output caller; no completeness/performance/OSfault measurement claim"})
rows=[]
for p in sorted(records.iterdir()):
    if p.is_file():
        rows.append({"path":p.name,"bytes":p.stat().st_size,"sha256":file_sha(p)})
write_json("MANIFEST.json",rows)
print(json.dumps({"records":str(records),"source":revision,"outcomes":outcomes,"binaries":binaries,"headroom_after":shutil.disk_usage(Path.home()).free}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(outcomes)==4 and all(code==0 for code in outcomes.values()) else 1)
